meta_description:
52K likes, 96 comments - elleindia on September 12, 2026: "#ELLEDigitalCoverStars: Two rebels, two very different approaches to rebellion. Bhuvan Bam (@bhuvan.bam22) and Gurfateh Pirzada (@gurfatehpirzada) step into the shoes of Rash Behari Bose and Bagha Jatin for ‘The Revolutionaries’ and discover that playing men defined by conviction demands more than just looking the part. From unlearning a decade of YouTube to gaining 15 kg of muscle, this is a story of stepping outside the familiar and finding strength in the unexpected. Head to the 🔗 in the bio to read more.
______________________________________
On @bhuvan.bam22: Rannvijay jacket set by @gopivaiddesigns. Uncut diamond, emerald and ruby ring by @khuranajewelleryhouse

On @gurfatehpirzada: Arjun Jodhpuri set by @gopivaiddesigns.
________________________________________
Editorial Director: Ainee Nizami Ahmedi (@aineenizamiahmedi)
Photographer: Indra Joshi (@indrajoshi)
Asst. Fashion Editor: Tejashree Raul (@tejashreeraul) 
Jr. Graphic Designer: Shawnn Lourdess (@shawnn_lourdess)
Makeup: Mahima Wachher (@makeupby_mahimawachher) (Gurfateh), Payal Bhatia (@payalbhatiamua) (Bhuvan)
Hair: Tejbahadur Kumar (@hairby_tej) (Gurfateh), Sahil More (@sahilmore_hair) (Bhuvan)
Words by: Vishakha Punjabi (@vishakha_punjabi)
Editorial Coordinator: Nirja Shah (@nirjashahh)
Assisted by: Idris Nidham (@iidrrisss), Hardika Singh (@hardika.singhh) (Styling), Disha Talwar (Bookings)
Location Courtesy: DEA (@deamumbai) 
Artist Reputation Management: Dharma Collab Artists Agency (@dcaatalent) (Gurfateh); Jio Creative Labs (@jio_creative_labs) (Bhuvan) 
________________________________________
#ELLECover #CoverStars".
